summary.name: Life Note
summary.one_liner: Life Note is an AI journaling app for iPhone, Android and the web where AI mentors modeled on the writings of historical thinkers respond to your entries.
use_cases: getting feedback on personal reflections from historical thinkers
spotting recurring patterns in your thoughts and feelings
mood and emotion tracking over time
summary.what_it_does: Life Note lets you write journal entries and receive replies from AI mentors that are described as grounded in the writings of 1,000+ historical figures across 20+ disciplines, and each reply can reportedly be traced to its source. The AI links new entries to past ones to show patterns, and it maps emotions over time on an emotion weather map. Voice dictation transcribes spoken entries. Users can export or delete their data, and connect their journal to ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or other MCP clients. The page also describes an art feature that creates a personalized piece every week.
notable: AI mentors such as Marcus Aurelius, Carl Jung and Maya Angelou reply in response to journal entries
Entries are encrypted with AES-GCM and the app can be locked with a PIN or biometrics
Journal can be connected to ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini via MCP
Listed in awesome-mac under Journaling as freeware
caveats: Premium tier offers the deepest personalization; free tier limits Weekly Letter and Inner Portrait to users who write 3 entries a week
Not a replacement for professional mental health care, according to the page
Page marketing claims about user mental health improvement are unverified
